name: lv_obj_set_scroll_dir

ownership.argument: borrows a live LVGL object; scroll direction flags of a page-owned widget

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-11-4.100.155 image/IDB: Sets the 4-bit scroll_dir field of the widget's spec_attr (allocating it on demand). Located by its field layout in the LVGL v9.0 lv_obj_spec_attr_t and by the firmware's own Lua binding of the same method.

notes: Static recovery only; Mirage is emulator evidence. UI owner thread only. The object must be a live LVGL object created on this page.
